title: Design YouTube Frontend
definition: Designing YouTube requires a focus on Video Streaming (HLS/DASH protocols), Infinite Scrolling for the feed, Lazy Loading thumbnails, heavy CDN utilization, and WebSockets for real-time live stream chat.
simpleExplanation: A system that buffers video chunks so playback never pauses, lazy-loads millions of thumbnails, and handles a chat room with 100,000 people typing at once.
diagramContent:
graph TD
  Client[Browser] -->|HLS Stream| Edge[Edge Video CDN]
  Client -->|Infinite Scroll| API[API Gateway]
  API --> Search[Search Service]
  API --> Recs[Recommendation Engine]
  Client -->|WebSocket| Chat[Live Chat Service]
